comment: The vectors binding Prima.BridgeAuth (Elixir) and apps/mcp-bridge/auth.mjs (Node): both suites derive every key, canonical string, header and sealed value here from the root and fields, decode every valid root text to the root, accept every valid field and refuse every invalid field and every invalid root text, parse every accepted header as its kind to its fields and MAC, and refuse every malformed header as its kind. Integers are written in decimal in canonical strings and headers; a header names its body's hex SHA-256, the canonical string's last line, as body=, which an accepted header parses to as its body_hash.
